# cloudflare_zero_trust_casb_webhooks (Data Source)

Accepted Permissions

- `Zero Trust Read`
- `Zero Trust Write`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000

### Read-Only

- `result` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result))

<a id="nestedatt--result"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result`

Read-Only:

- `authentication_type` (String) Type of authentication used for the webhook.
Available values: "Basic Auth", "None", "Bearer Auth", "Static Headers", "HMAC-Signing".
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook configuration was created.
- `destination_url` (String) Target URL for the webhook configuration. Where resulting data will be sent.
- `headers` (Attributes List) List of header keys configured for this webhook. Values are not included for security reasons. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--headers))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the specific webhook configuration.
- `label` (String) Account-specified display label for the webhook configuration.
- `status` (String) Current status of the webhook configuration. If disabled, data cannot be sent through this configuration.
Available values: "enabled", "disabled".
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook configuration was last updated.
- `version` (Number) Version number of the configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--result--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.headers`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Header key name (lowercase).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Header value. This field is never returned in API responses for security reasons.
